title: Amanah Geupeucaya Keu Krueng .
intro: Saboh jiwa geuhadapi saboh dekrit nyang hana mungken, dipat udep sidroe aneuk baroe lahe meugantung lam timbangan. Dibimbing le ilham ilahi, saboh peurintah nyang putôh asa geupatuh, dan saboh rahasia nyang meuhareuga geupeuduek bak arus, teuma geubri pulang deungon cara nyang hana teuduga.
clues: Lon tinggai dimiyueb bayangan sidroe tiran nyang peurintah poh mate aneuk agam nyang baroe lahe.
Saboh ilham ilahi teuka bak lon, geubri instruksi keu lon untuk lon cok tindakan nyang putus asa dan peudeh hate.
Lon peuduek aneuk manyak lon nyang meuharga lam saboh peti dan lon peuduek ateuh krueng nyang ji-ile.
Haté ulôn djeuët keu kosong, dan karab ulôn peugah rahsia njan, tapi Allah geupeukong tekad ulôn.
Lon kirem ureung untuk ikot perjalanan aneuk miet nyan u miyueb bak arus jiba dada nyan.
Aneuk njan djiteumeung lé rumoh tangga tiran njan, dan akhédjih, ulôn djipeusaboh lom deungon aneuk ulôn dan djeuët keu ureuëng njang jaga.

arabic: وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَرْضِعِيهِ ۖ فَإِذَا خِفْتِ عَلَيْهِ فَأَلْقِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَلَا تَخَافِى وَلَا تَحْزَنِىٓ ۖ إِنَّا رَآدُّوهُ إِلَيْكِ وَجَاعِلُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verse: And We inspired to the mother of Moses, "Suckle him; but when you fear for him, cast him into the river and do not fear and do not grieve. Indeed, We will return him to you and will make him [one] of the messengers." (28:7)
